sloka: राज्ञस्तु भवनद्वारि सो ऽवतीर्य रथोत्तमात् ।अवाङ्मुखो दीनमनाः प्रविवेशानिवारितः ।। ७.५२.५ ॥
transliteration: rājñastu bhavanadvāri so 'vatīrya rathottamāt ।avāṅmukho dīnamanāḥ praviveśānivāritaḥ ।। 7.52.5 ॥

translations.english: At the king's palace gate, he alighted from his excellent chariot and, with a downcast face and sorrowful mind, entered unhindered.
translations.hindi: महाराज श्रीरामचंद्र जी ने दुर्धेषे राक्षसराज रावण को मार कर तुमको भी जीत लिआ है
